 Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc. Issues Voluntary Nationwide Consumer-Level Recall of One Lot of Propranolol Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules, USP, 60 mg, Due to Potential Metal Contamination
 News provided by
 Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc.
 Nov 16, 2026, 08:28 ET
 Share this article
 Share this article
 BERKELEY HEIGHTS, N.J. , Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc. (Breckenridge) is voluntarily recalling to the consumer level one lot of Propranolol Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules, USP, 60 mg, manufactured by Adare Pharma Solutions, due to potential metal contamination.
 Risk Statement 
 Continue Reading
 Product Photos 
 Use of product from the affected lot could potentially cause lacerations of soft tissues in the oral cavity, esophagus, stomach, or intestine. The affected lot shared intermediate material suspected to be the source of metal contamination identified in a separate lot that was not released to market. To date, Breckenridge is not aware of any adverse events assessed to be related to this recall. Product from the affected lot subject to this recall was distributed nationwide to wholesalers and pharmacies between October 26, 2026 and November 04, 2026.
 Recalled Product 
 Product 
 Package Size 
 NDC 
 Lot Number 
 Expiration Date 
 Propranolol Hydrochloride Extended-Release Capsules, USP, 60 mg 
 100-count bottle 
 51991-817-01 
 PK25110035 
 May 2029 
 What Consumers Should Do 
 Consumers should immediately stop taking product from the lot subject to this recall and contact their physician or healthcare provider for medical advice and replacement instructions. Consumers should return any unused portion of the affected product to the pharmacy where it was obtained.
 Consumers should contact their physician or healthcare provider if they have experienced any problems that may be related to taking or using this product.
 Wholesalers, pharmacies, and other retail entities should check inventory for the recalled lot, quarantine any affected product, and not distribute or dispense the affected product. Entities that further distributed the product should notify their sub-accounts to the retail level.
 For questions or concerns regarding this recall, contact Qualanex, Breckenridge's designated recall service provider, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time:
 Phone:  1-855-736-0807
 Email:   [email protected] 
 Reporting Adverse Events 
 Adverse reactions or quality problems experienced with the use of this product may be reported to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program:
 Online:   www.fda.gov/medwatch/report.htm 
 Mail or fax:  Download the reporting form at www.fda.gov/MedWatch/getforms.htm , or call 1-800-332-1088 to request a form. Complete and return the form to the address provided, or fax it to 1-800-FDA-0178.
 This recall is being conducted with the knowledge of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
